title: smtp: unit tests for fallback_routing header parser
description:
Test suite for fallback_routing(), independent of the daemon.

What: tests in crates/smtp/src/sieve_client.rs or crates/smtp/tests/sieve_client_tests.rs

Oracle for all tests: expected values are derived by hand from the RFC 2919 List-ID spec and RFC 1036 Newsgroups header format — NOT from the code under test.

Tests:
1. newsgroups_single: 'Newsgroups: comp.lang.rust' → [FileInto("newsgroup:comp.lang.rust")]
2. newsgroups_multi: 'Newsgroups: comp.lang.rust, comp.lang.c' → two FileInto actions
3. newsgroups_takes_priority_over_listid: both headers present → use Newsgroups only
4. list_id_angle_brackets: 'List-ID: Rust Lang <rustlang.googlegroups.com>' → FileInto("newsgroup:rustlang.googlegroups.com")
5. list_id_no_brackets: 'List-ID: rustlang.lists.example.com' → FileInto("newsgroup:rustlang.lists.example.com")
6. x_list_id_variant: 'X-List-ID: <foo.bar.example>' → FileInto("newsgroup:foo.bar.example")
7. x_listid_variant: 'X-Listid: <baz.qux.example>' → FileInto("newsgroup:baz.qux.example")
8. normalization: list-id with uppercase and spaces → all lowercase, spaces→dots
9. nothing_found: no relevant headers → [Keep]
10. body_not_scanned: header section ends at blank line; newsgroup in body is ignored
